_note: Tier 2, oldest end. Late October 2025: the riots, New York and debt jubilee sessions.

mentions.claim_text: He says that praying into a 24-hour window he saw darkness that would cause so much chaos and havoc in the nation that it would bring people to the table, because they do not realise they are playing with fire.
mentions.quote: it would bring a people to the table because they don't realize
mentions.falsify_match: National chaos severe enough to force negotiations.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The 24-hour window has no start date attached.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a slush fund in government with money going to Ukraine and to pet projects, and compares it to what went on with Fauci and the laboratories.
mentions.quote: money going to Ukraine, money going to pet projects
mentions.falsify_match: Documented diversion of US funds through Ukraine into unaccounted projects.
mentions.falsify_miss: None documented. No sum, agency or programme is named.

mentions.claim_text: In prayer he asks whether the shakings are God's hand as on Pharaoh, and recalls being told to say that America will be humbled because it has stiffened its neck.
mentions.quote: I'm going to humble America. They've stiffened their neck toward me
mentions.falsify_match: A national humbling of America identifiable as the one described.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Humbling has no threshold, so any difficulty reads as confirmation.

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees money being used to influence into Ukraine.
mentions.quote: This money is to influence into Ukraine
mentions.falsify_match: Evidence of US money used for political influence in Ukraine.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. No sum or party named.

mentions.claim_text: He asks whether to say it aloud, then says an arrow goes from Washington DC into Kyiv for special interests, that they are trying to protect it, and that the money is not accounted for with no accountability over it.
mentions.quote: The arrow goes from Washington DC into Kyiv for special interest
mentions.falsify_match: An audit finding US funds to Ukraine unaccounted for and routed to special interests.
mentions.falsify_miss: No such finding. Oversight reporting on Ukraine aid has been published throughout by the Defense Department inspector general.

mentions.claim_text: He says he hears the John Lennon song Imagine playing and asks what it means, places it in New York, and then says he saw a flash and could see the buildings.
mentions.quote: I hear that. Imagine all the people. It's in the New York
mentions.falsify_match: An explosion or comparable flash event in New York City.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Imagine is played at Strawberry Fields in Central Park continuously, which is where the association most likely comes from.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a flash, screams, then nothing, then finds himself in Ukraine again, says he does not know what it is and will not assume anything.
mentions.quote: Like a flash. Screams. I could hear screams
mentions.falsify_match: A detonation causing mass casualties in New York, connected to Ukraine.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He states three times that he does not know what it is, which is a real hedge and is recorded as one.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw great distress on the cities afterwards, fires throughout New York, buildings burning down and riots so bad that people put their families in cars and left.
mentions.quote: I saw great great riots in New York
mentions.falsify_match: Riots in New York with buildings burning and residents fleeing.

mentions.claim_text: He says America would have to be disarmed for a new world order and that the only way he saw it was mass chaos with shootings, engineered by certain wealthy individuals, one of whom he names.
mentions.quote: America would have to be disarmed
mentions.falsify_match: Federal disarmament of Americans following engineered unrest.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The attribution to a named individual is an allegation offered without support.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a number on a named official, fifty thousand dollars or possibly five hundred thousand, seen fading on a billboard, and prays the blood over her, saying she is good at her job.
mentions.quote: the number that is on her for $50,000 could be another zero
mentions.falsify_match: A bounty or contract on the named official at one of those figures.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He hedges the number by a factor of ten in the same breath, which removes most of what a figure would add.

mentions.claim_text: He describes people organising to take food from Walmart and pillage at a set time on a Saturday, and says he is not trying to scare but to prepare.
mentions.quote: We're going to go and start taking food from Walmart
mentions.falsify_match: Organised mass looting of a named retailer at a set time.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The Saturday has no date attached to it.

mentions.claim_text: He says the Titanic is going down, that the dollar is done and there is no saving it, that America is not coming back and what is coming back is Jesus, and notes that people get angry with him for saying so.
mentions.quote: The dollar is done. I've already told you there's no saving it
mentions.falsify_match: The dollar losing reserve status or collapsing.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. Undated, but this is the most absolute form the dollar claim takes anywhere in the corpus: no saving it, stated without a prayer condition.

mentions.claim_text: He describes a debt jubilee in which everything is lumped together as if the nation filed bankruptcy, followed by a reset of the system with digital money, and says he saw an American flag and a dollar bill.
mentions.quote: it's like you filed bankruptcy as a nation
mentions.falsify_match: A US debt jubilee followed by a digital currency reset.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither. The two-step sequence is specific enough to be wrong.

mentions.claim_text: He says New York is in trouble and a great shaking is coming to it, naming the real estate market, and that many billionaires are fleeing.
mentions.quote: A great shaking is coming to New York with the real estate market
mentions.falsify_match: A New York commercial real estate collapse with high net worth outflow.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Note this is given the week before the New York mayoral election, when wealth-flight commentary was already saturating the news.

mentions.claim_text: He says the California governor's days are numbered, clarifies that he means removal rather than death, says he saw him fading away concerning California, and rejects the reading that it means political violence.
mentions.quote: Gavin's days are numbered. I'm not talking about death
mentions.falsify_match: The California governor leaving office early.
mentions.falsify_miss: He serves out his term, which ends in January 2027. Ruling out death and violence narrows this usefully.

mentions.claim_text: He says there is lizard business going on across continents and that they protect a bloodline, acknowledges people will say he is way out there, and reports being told to watch the walls from Egypt to the cave paintings.
mentions.quote: There's lizard stuff going on and people go, you are way out there
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a hidden reptilian bloodline is not a claim any evidence could confirm or refute.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as America goes so goes the world, and that this is not one person's problem because the body of Christ is a team with no member more special than another.
mentions.quote: As America goes, so does the world
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: an exhortation about shared responsibility.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw a lot that night which he will never be able to talk about publicly, that he has told them only the surface, and that by God's power they can uncover and take the head of the snake.
mentions.quote: I'll never be able to talk about publicly, but I saw a lot
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: material stated to exist and withheld permanently.
mentions.falsify_miss: Cannot fail. This is the second withholding of this kind on file, alongside the specific Israel and Iran targets.
